uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When this Pokémon deals damage to opposing Pokémon, or as time passes, the Torrent gauge increases to a max of 100. If a move is used when the Torrent gauge exceeds 50, 50 points of the gauge is consumed and the move becomes boosted. The rate at which the Torrent gauge increases depends on your current HP with thresholds at: above 66% HP, below 66% HP, and below 33% HP. Every second gain 1/2/3 Torrent gauge.

Piplup shoots a blast of water, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Basic and Boosted attacks increase Torrent gauge by 2/3/4. When evolved into Prinplup or Empoleon, basic attacks become melee ranged. The user slices with their wings, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Boosted attack increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20. This Pokémon heals 15% of damage dealt with basic and boosted attacks.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

The user blasts a forceful shot of water in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move deals increased damage.

The user launches a watery blast in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and stunning them for 0.5s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move leaves behind a whirlpool for 3s which deals damage to opposing Pokémon, and heals the user when they stand in it, every 0.5s.
Reduces this moves cooldown by 30% of the remaining cooldown when it hits Pokémon from the opposing team.

The user becomes unstoppable for 1s as they create a violent swirling whirlpool around themself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon every 0.25s up to 4 hits. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt against Pokémon on the opposing team (this healing is halved against wild Pokémon). Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move will throw opposing Pokémon for 0.6s and the user will slash once at the end of the move in the designated direction extending the unstoppable duration to 1.33s. The healing of the move is increased to 60% of the damage dealt against Pokémon on the opposing team, and 30% against wild Pokémon.
Increased damage and increased healing to 60% of the damage dealt (this healing is halved against wild Pokémon).

The user jabs its sharply pointed beak in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move applies a 40% slow for 2s.

Has the user charge towards a designated target, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon with wings of steel and shoving them for 0.25s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move grants the user a shield for 3s. This shield will not stack with itself.

Has the user lunge at blinding speed in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 40% for 5s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge. When empowered by Torrent, this move will also lower the special defense of those hit by 60% for 3s.
Lowers the base cooldown of this move by 1s.

Has the user slide at high speed in the designated direction and form a whirlpool on impact, or when the maximum distance is reached, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1s. The whirlpool remains centered on the user for 7s and applies a 50% slow to opposing Pokémon in the area. The slow lasts 1s when opposing Pokémon leave the area. Empoleon is unstoppable throughout this move. The longer the user slides, the faster the recovery to perform other actions. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when the move connects. While the whirlpool is active the amount of Torrent gauge gained per second is increased to 12/18/24.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Sovereign Slide
source.originalDescription: Has the user slide at high speed in the designated direction and form a whirlpool on impact, or when the maximum distance is reached, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1s. The whirlpool remains centered on the user for 7s and applies a 50% slow to opposing Pokémon in the area. The slow lasts 1s when opposing Pokémon leave the area. Empoleon is unstoppable throughout this move. The longer the user slides, the faster the recovery to perform other actions. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when the move connects. While the whirlpool is active the amount of Torrent gauge gained per second is increased to 12/18/24.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Sovereign Slide は 相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
